description: The layered treatment goes live on the Home Page only, on a preview deployment: the muted duotone tile as the page wall with content on solid cream panels echoing the invitation's arch window, plus full-color motif accents in text-free zones (hero band, dividers). The full-color pattern never sits under body text; text contrast is measured against the cream panel. The Team Lead reviews on his phone and desktop and rules: layered as-is, wall-only, accents-only, or drop. The ruling is recorded and unblocks (or closes) the site-wide rollout. No other Page changes in this slice.
title: Home prototype of the layered pattern treatment, ending in the Team Lead's ruling
acceptance_criteria: Home renders the layered treatment on a preview deployment; all other Pages are unchanged
No body text sits over the pattern at any viewport; WCAG contrast verified against the cream panel
prefers-reduced-motion shows a static treatment; no parallax or fixed-background effects
The Team Lead's design-direction ruling is recorded on this issue and the rollout issue is updated to match
